experiments: Five sandbox-staged cases: four git experiments in mktemp scratch repos (selective restore, path-limited stash, banned-command negative control, mixed-file content capture) plus a local man-page documentation inspection of the installed git. V3 (continuation criteria) is process guidance per the record's own plan — not mechanically testable.

cases.name: V1a path-limited git restore: user WIP survives, agent edit gone, original error reproduces
cases.objective: verify the record's primary selective-rollback mechanism end to end in a scratch repo

expected.successCriteria: exit 0, user WIP intact, agent edit reverted, original error reproduced
expected.failureCriteria: user work lost, agent edit survives, or the check outcome changes

cases.name: V1b path-limited stash: same guarantees, change recoverable
cases.objective: verify git stash push -- <path> as the alternative selective rollback

expected.successCriteria: exit 0, user WIP intact, agent edit stashed (recoverable), original error reproduced

cases.name: V1c negative control: repo-wide git checkout . destroys user work (why it is banned)
cases.objective: demonstrate the blast radius of the banned blanket restore on the user's unrelated uncommitted work

expected.successCriteria: exit 0, user WIP destroyed by the banned command (damage demonstrated)
expected.failureCriteria: user work survives the blanket restore (the ban would be unjustified)

cases.name: V1d mixed file: content-capture rollback preserves the user's hunk, removes the agent's
cases.objective: verify the record's prescribed mechanism when the agent's edit and the user's pre-existing WIP share one file (capture pre-edit content before the first edit, re-apply on failure)

expected.successCriteria: exit 0, user hunk intact, agent hunk gone, working tree at exactly the user's WIP, original error reproduced

cases.name: V2 doc-based: installed git's own man pages on restore/stash selectivity (local, no network)
cases.objective: verify against the ACTUAL documentation of the installed git 2.53.0: path-scoped working-tree restore, interactive hunk selection, stash push with pathspec

expected.successCriteria: exit 0, all six documented phrases found in the local man pages
expected.failureCriteria: man pages unavailable or documented statements differ
